name: agent-manager.investigation-evidence
purpose: Collect bounded run reports for an explicit investigation subject set, preserving unknown evidence as unknown.

run_ids.description: One to eight explicit run identifiers; cohort membership is never inferred.

assumptions: agent-manager is running and its run report projection is reachable
run reports are bounded owner projections; transcript bodies are not read
invariants: read only; no launches, mutations, cursor movement, or recommendations
one report and accounting read per declared subject run
report and accounting failures remain explicit; any available sibling is retained as partial evidence
the envelope is printed exactly once on every path

signals.subjects: Bounded subject rows include owner-reported duration, event gap, repeated tool calls, time-accounting, reported aggregate tokens, model and goal outcome; missing values are null. Accounting carries owner-reported non-cache and cache tokens, known flags, charge and terminal state; a failed accounting read is unknown. Source completeness and freshness remain unknown.
signals.available: Subjects with at least one available projection
signals.unknown: Subjects with at least one unavailable projection
signals.coverage: complete only when both projections and report evidence are available for every subject; this is not source completeness or freshness

outputs.evidence: Explicit subject run IDs and projection command identities; never transcript bodies
